caption: James Sowerby, Boletus versicolor (turkey tail), plate 229 from Coloured Figures of English Fungi or Mushrooms (1799), hand-coloured engraving; the pencilled name below, Polystictus versicolor, is a later reader’s
alt: A hand-coloured engraving of a broken branch, mossy green, crowded with thin, fan-shaped brackets banded in rings of orange, brown, grey and cream, with a cluster of pale grey brackets at its foot. Below, the engraved name Boletus versicolor and, in a later hand in pencil, Polystictus versicolor.
